facts.fact: MFWA reports that SEN TV columnist Abdou Nguer was charged on 18 February 2026 with spreading false information and remanded in custody after contesting the Justice Ministry's statement on a student's death.
MFWA reports that on 12 November 2025 a court convicted Abdou Nguer of insulting the Head of State and sentenced him to six months, three to be served, and a 200,000 CFA franc fine.
